data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all repository files and correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard, safe binary package with pinned checksums and no top-level execution. The qwen model's 'inconclusive' verdict was solely the result of LLM API errors, which carry no verdict signal. There is no evidence of malicious injection.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered by the qwen model failing to audit 3 out of 4 files due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400 and LLMResponseError), resulting in an 'inconclusive' overall status. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore, .SRCINFO, and PKGBUILD due to LLM API errors.
learnings: LLM API errors should trigger automatic retries or fallback to another model rather than immediately failing the audit and causing an inconclusive verdict.
The adjudication system should recognize when an 'inconclusive' verdict is purely due to tool/LLM errors and defer to a complete, successful audit from another model.
